g.text: [prefix not an EU VAT prefix, or format invalid]
The VIES outcome is dialog state (`RecipientView.pendingVerification`) until the
customer is saved; a cancelled dialog discards it. Verification only ever runs on
this explicit click — never automatically or on a schedule, per the EU VIES terms
of use («adr-023,ADR-023»). The button is additionally disabled while the field
is blank, format-invalid, or non-EU. Customers only; the seller profile and
additional seller VAT registrations are format-validated but never queried
